vimanam main branch [Resource] (score 7.05)

Merged both vimanam PRs to main with admin override (user explicitly authorized bypassing the 1-review branch protection, which is unsatisfiable on a solo repo since GitHub forbids self-approval). Sequence that matters for stacked PRs with squash merge: retarget #92 to main FIRST (deleteBranchOnMerge would auto-close it when #91's branch died), squash-merge #91 -> 7e0e336, then git rebase --onto origin/main <old-base-tip> feat/diff to drop the already-squashed commits, force-push, re-run CI, squash-merge #92 -> db42292. Also updated PR #92's body to remove the stale 'stacked on #91' line before merging, since squash uses the body as the commit message. Main verified green: fmt, clippy on 1.96 and 1.97.1, 175 tests, plus release-build smoke tests of all four features and diff exit codes 3/0/0. [Resource] (score 6.86)

CI is a timing adversary local gates are not: a race with a microsecond window on a dev machine is a real defect on a loaded runner. Anything inserted into serve startup must re-verify the pre-handshake durability test's assumptions — and that test's matcher ('session attached') matches both the memory-level and serve-level log lines, which is how the widened window was caught.
